_comment_accounting: Accounting add-on defaults (docs/plans/ledger-design.md). Merged into the site's configuration only while ngdpbase.addons.accounting.enabled is true; the site's app-custom-config.json overrides any entry. Every action is a permission whose entry carries its audit rule; money actions refuse when their audit record cannot be written, and the riskiest ask for a fresh sign-in (step-up).
_comment_categories: Income and expense categories (D-023, D-034): a starter chart that follows QuickBooks, keyed by account code. Each is { "name", "type" (income, other-income, cost-of-goods, expense, other-expense), "detailType" (QuickBooks' detail type) }; the older "<code>": "<name>" still works, its type read from the number. A map, so a site adds, renames or removes (false) one code at a time in app-custom-config.json. Receipts offer income types; money out offers the rest.
_comment_chart_roles: Categories with a job (D-032): where a bounced check's bank fee goes (and a repaid fee is set against), where its penalty goes, and the penalty the bounce form fills in, in minor units (0: none).
_comment_accounts: Where money sits (D-031): bank accounts, keyed by id so each layer adds or changes one; false removes a shipped one. Each bank account may carry "routing-number" (nine digits) and "account-number", which must be a $VAR reference to an environment variable (e.g. "$CHECKING_ACCOUNT_NUMBER"), never the number itself: ngdpbase resolves it and hides it as a secret (below). Screens show the last four digits; fund-manage holders can read the full number, and every read is audited. Cash on Hand is built in. One active bank account is the default: ACH, Zelle and bank transfers land there, and money out comes from it. Opening balances are set by the treasurer on the Set an Account's Opening Balance page, not here.
_comment_sensitive_values: Bank account numbers inside the accounts map are secrets (ngdpbase v5.21.0, #1889): never shown on the admin screen, in logs or in the audit log.

ledger-read.description: See ledger entries, including who paid or was paid

ledger-self.description: See your own receipts: your gifts and statements, your dues payments (D-037)

ledger-record.description: Record money out of a fund, and money received (a receipt)

audit.description: Ledger entry or receipt posted; no money moves without a record

ledger-adjust.description: Void a posted entry and post its replacement, or move money between funds

audit.description: Ledger entry voided or replaced, or money moved between funds

receipt-refund.description: Refund money received: return all or part of a receipt to the payer

audit.description: Receipt refunded; the record keeps the receipt number and amount

ledger-export.description: Download the ledger as CSV for the books of record

audit.description: Ledger exported as CSV; the record keeps the period, row count and file hash

fund-manage.description: Set up the books: create, rename and close funds, and set accounts' opening balances

audit.description: Fund created, changed or closed, or an account's opening balance set

treasurer.name: treasurer
treasurer.description: Records and corrects the organization's money

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Treasurer keeps the ledger
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: The treasurer role holds every accounting permission. Grant ledger-summary-read to other roles in the site's own policy.

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Everyone signed in sees their own receipts
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: Every signed-in person sees the receipts whose payer is their own person record, and nothing else (D-037): the roles core's self-service policies name, and the treasurer.

_comment_accounting_database: The accounting database, declared so ngdpbase's DatabaseManager.openAddonDatabase will open it (ngdpbase #1860). encrypt 'optional' per D-010: SQLCipher when NGDPBASE_DATABASE_KEY is set, plain SQLite with a boot warning otherwise.
_comment_receiptproviders: Providers for money coming in (D-017, D-028, D-029): a list merged by id. The manual provider (cash, check and other money recorded by hand) is always available; online providers (Stripe) come later.
